scope: Generate, rewrite, translate, edit, and review Brazilian Portuguese prose while preserving semantic responsibility, register, protected spans, and domain terminology.
autonomous_envelope: Produce or revise PT-BR text artifacts from supplied context without external publication, sending, account changes, or other side effects. The skill may autonomously return text, including a no-change result, but high-consequence factual, legal, medical, financial, contractual, or public-release decisions remain outside this envelope unless independently validated by the surrounding workflow.

side_effect_safety.reason: The autonomous envelope ends at returning or locally producing text; the skill does not authorize external sending, publishing, account changes, or irreversible mutations.

idempotency.reason: The skill does not perform external mutations; callers own file overwrite and persistence semantics when saving generated text.

rollback_or_compensation.reason: Text outputs are replaceable artifacts and no irreversible external mutation is authorized by this skill.

concurrency_control.reason: The skill does not authorize concurrent external writes; callers own output-path locking or merge behavior if multiple jobs persist text.

limitations: Naturalness and semantic-preservation behavior remain model-dependent; the executable regression test verifies load-bearing skill contracts and suite integrity, while behavioral quality should also be spot-checked when changing the instructions or target model.
The skill does not independently verify external facts, legal validity, medical accuracy, financial correctness, or source truth unless the surrounding workflow provides and validates those inputs.
Publishing, sending, or other external side effects are outside the autonomous envelope.
